asset_state_definitions.missing: Required referenced path absent from the explicitly provided branch roots.
asset_state_definitions.unverified: Branch roots or supported metadata unavailable; never promoted to working content.
asset_state_definitions.optional_absent: Alternative renderer variant or authoring/collision companion, not automatically a runtime fault.
